notes.title: liteCam Game Version 4.9.0.3 has been released (MINOR UPGRADE)
notes.notes:
liteCam Game: 100 FPS Game Capture 4.9.0.3 minor upgrade has been released.

Updated features

Reduce lagging on game while recording(Beta).
The default Codec for Video Recording and Game Recording been changed to 'RSUPPORT MPEG-4 Video Codec'.
Support conversion of videos recorded using 'RSUPPORT MPEG-4 Video Codec'.
Support conversion of videos with 1920 x 1280 resolution or higher.
Exception handling added when converting video files.
Resolve the issue where video file could not be converted to the end.
Compatibility with DirectX 9 enhanced.
DirectX/OpendGL hooking Module fixed. 
Resolve the issue where some .AVI files do not play on Preview Window.
Fix some sentence resource.


Thank you
liteCam Team

notes.title: liteCam 100FPS Game Capture Patch Released
notes.notes:
Hello

A patch for liteCam 100FPS Game Capture has been released. 
Released version is liteCam 100FPS Game Capture version 4.8.0.4

Updated features:
Dual Sound recording setting added.
DirectX/OpendGL hooking Module fixed.
Size of FPS Counter/overlay reduced by 30% 

 REMARKS
Update your liteCam Version installed on your computer and try to record you game play or any activities on your Computer screen.

If you encounter any issues, crashes, features not working well, etc
Let us know the game titles,
Also, send us your Computer system information and liteCam log files

How to create and export below 2 files; 
1. System Information 
Please note this is the default location if you do not change the steam library. 
1-1) For 64 bit windows; 
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\liteCam Game\Info.exe 
1-2) For 32 bit windows: 
C:\Program Files\Steam\SteamApps\common\liteCam Game\Info.exe 
2) You will be prompted with the 「System - Info」 dialog box. Click File > Save from the dialog box. This will save your system information as a TXT file and you can send this file. 

2. *.log” files 
You will find the “Logs” directory from liteCam’s work directory in your system. (\My Documents\liteCam\Log's Directory) There will be “*.log” files saved in the directory. 

Zip them file and send to litecam@rsupport.com


Thank you
liteCam Team
